title: The F-test and the ANOVA table

cues.en: Instructor: This video is part two of the math underlying the analysis of variants.
cues.zh: 講師：這是變異數分析背後數學的第二部分。

cues.en: You'll see that the math here is in fact, even simpler than the math that I introduced you to in the previous video.
cues.zh: 你會看到，這裡的數學其實比上一支影片更簡單。

cues.en: So the previous video, we actually had to do things like squaring, and, you know, we had to think about degrees of freedom.
cues.zh: 上一支影片還得做平方，也得思考自由度。

cues.en: And you know, if that was a bit of a challenge, then wait till you see the math in this video, all we're doing is dividing.
cues.zh: 如果覺得有點挑戰，看看這支影片的數學吧，只要做除法。

cues.en: This is like middle school math here, it's really great.
cues.zh: 這是國中程度的數學，真棒。

cues.en: This slide is literally the same slide I showed in the previous video, this is just a reminder of the important terms that we need here.
cues.zh: 這張與上一支影片的投影片完全相同，只是提醒這裡需要的重要術語。

cues.en: And in fact, for this video, mostly we need the sum of squares between and the sum of squares within.
cues.zh: 這支影片主要需要組間平方和與組內平方和。

cues.en: And just as a quick reminder, the idea is that the sum of squares between tells us about the variance, the variability in our dataset
cues.zh: 快速提醒，組間平方和告訴我們，資料集中的變異，

cues.en: that we can attribute to the different groups, the different levels within each factor.
cues.zh: 有多少可以歸因於不同群組，也就是各因子中的不同水準。

cues.en: And when we compute this quantity, we are ignoring individuals, we are averaging all the people together within one cell or all the, you know, jelly beans, or elephants, or whatever it is
cues.zh: 計算時，忽略個體，把一格內所有人平均，或者是所有雷根糖、大象，不論你的依變數

cues.en: that your dependent and variable is.
cues.zh: 是什麼。

cues.en: All the data points within each cell of each ANOVA table, so within each level, get averaged together.
cues.zh: 每個 ANOVA 表格的各格，也就是各水準內的所有資料點，都先平均。

cues.en: And for these sum squares between, all we care about is the differences between the group means and the total mean of the entire data
cues.zh: 對組間平方和而言，只關心群組平均值與整個資料總平均值之間的差異，

cues.en: when ignoring all of the factors.
cues.zh: 總平均值忽略所有因子。

cues.en: And that has k - 1 degrees of freedom, where k is the total number of levels, or the total number of groups.
cues.zh: 它有 K 減 1 個自由度，K 是總水準數，或群組總數。

cues.en: And then we have the SS Within or the sum squared within also called SS error.
cues.zh: 接著是組內 SS，也稱為誤差 SS。

cues.en: And this is the individual variability within each group, so we take each individual person within each cell,
cues.zh: 這是各組內的個體變異，取每個格子，

cues.en: or within each level and compute the variance relative to, not the total mean of the entire dataset, but just the mean of that individual cell,
cues.zh: 或每個水準內的個體，計算相對於該格平均值的變異，而不是相對於整個資料集的總平均值。

cues.en: this is the same mean that we have over here.
cues.zh: 這與這裡使用的平均值相同。

cues.en: Okay, and this one has n - k degrees of freedom.
cues.zh: 這一個有 N 減 K 個自由度。

cues.en: Again, n is the total number of people in our dataset, or you know, the total number of slow (indistinct), the total number of things that you have,
cues.zh: N 同樣是資料集中的總人數，或總共多少隻慢……［語音不清］，總之是資料項目的總數，

cues.en: and k is the number of levels in our factor.
cues.zh: K 是因子中的水準數。

cues.en: All right, so now we need to bust out our middle school mathematics.
cues.zh: 現在拿出國中數學。

cues.en: We are going to go from a sum of squares to a mean of squares, and that's what we have here.
cues.zh: 把平方和轉成均方，這裡就是如此。

cues.en: So MS is for the mean of squares between and the mean of squares within.
cues.zh: MS 表示組間均方與組內均方。

cues.en: And it's really simple to calculate, all you have to do is divide each of these quantities by their associated degrees of freedom.
cues.zh: 計算非常簡單，只要把各個量除以對應的自由度。

cues.en: So pretty easy, ll that calculus you suffered through in university was all for nothing, you don't need any of that here.
cues.zh: 很容易，大學時辛苦學的微積分都白費了，這裡完全不需要。

cues.en: Okay, so now we get these two quantities, the mean of squares, and then we can finally compute our F statistic.
cues.zh: 得到這兩個均方之後，終於可以計算 F 統計量。

cues.en: And it is literally just the ratio of the mean square divided by, sorry, the mean square between, divided by the mean square within.
cues.zh: 就是均方除以——抱歉，組間均方除以組內均方。

cues.en: And just as a reminder of how to interpret this ratio, and this is something I discussed in a previous video, that it's a ratio, the F statistic is a ratio
cues.zh: 提醒一下如何解讀這個比值，之前影片討論過，F 統計量是一個比值，

cues.en: between all of the variability that we can attribute to our experimental factors, so the levels within each factor.
cues.zh: 比較所有能歸因於實驗因子，也就是各因子水準的變異，

cues.en: And this is the variability that we attribute to the individual variability, which includes individual differences, natural variations, sampling variability, measurement noise, and so on.
cues.zh: 與歸因於個體的變異，包括個體差異、自然變異、抽樣變異、量測雜訊等等。

cues.en: Okay, so that's our F statistic.
cues.zh: 這就是 F 統計量。

cues.en: And the F statistic has two degrees of freedom, this is the numerator degree of freedom and the denominator degree of freedom.
cues.zh: F 統計量有兩個自由度參數，分別是分子自由度與分母自由度。

cues.en: So the degrees of freedom for the MS between, and the degrees of freedom for the MS within.
cues.zh: 也就是組間 MS 的自由度，以及組內 MS 的自由度。

cues.en: So F statistic with two degrees of freedom, it's important that they go in this order, you can't swap the order here.
cues.zh: F 統計量的兩個自由度，順序很重要，不能交換。

cues.en: So it's always the numerator degrees of freedom and the denominator degrees of freedom.
cues.zh: 一定是先分子自由度，再分母自由度。

cues.en: All right, and that is our F test, and that is all the math behind an ANOVA.
cues.zh: 這就是 F 檢定，也是 ANOVA 背後的所有數學。

cues.en: So now once we've computed all these quantities, we can create something called the ANOVA table.
cues.zh: 計算所有這些量之後，可以建立 ANOVA 表。

cues.en: You might remember from the first video in this section that I said, when we start thinking about an ANOVA, we build up a table of our factors and our different manipulations,
cues.zh: 你可能記得，本單元第一支影片說，開始思考 ANOVA 時，先建立一張表格，列出因子與不同操弄，

cues.en: the things that we're looking at, the different independent variables.
cues.zh: 也就是研究的項目、不同自變數。

cues.en: And then I said, don't confuse that table with what is called the ANOVA table, so this is the ANOVA table.
cues.zh: 當時說，不要把那張表與 ANOVA 表搞混，這裡才是 ANOVA 表。

cues.en: And here's what it looks like, you can see there's a lot of terms in here, but it's actually nothing new, it's nothing that we haven't already described.
cues.zh: 樣子如下，裡面有很多項，但沒有任何新東西，全部都已經描述過。

cues.en: It's just putting all that information very neatly into one, nicely contained table.
cues.zh: 只是把所有資訊整齊地放在一張完整表格中。

cues.en: So here we have the source of variants, and the different quantities.
cues.zh: 這裡有變異來源，以及不同數量。

cues.en: So we have the between groups variance, the within groups variance, and the total variance.
cues.zh: 包括組間變異、組內變異與總變異。

cues.en: This is the sum of squares, the degrees of freedom, the mean square, and the F statistic, and then the P-value that's associated with this F statistic.
cues.zh: 這是平方和、自由度、均方、F 統計量，以及對應的 P 值。

cues.en: Again, all of this is stuff that we have been calculating already, and we're just organizing it together in one table.
cues.zh: 這些都是已經計算過的東西，只是整理在同一張表格。

cues.en: Now, a quick reminder that the null hypothesis of an ANOVA is that at least one mean, or sorry, the null hypothesis is that all the means of all the cells,
cues.zh: 快速提醒，ANOVA 的虛無假設，是至少一個平均值——抱歉，是所有格子，

cues.en: all the different levels are the same.
cues.zh: 所有不同水準的平均值都相同。

cues.en: The alternative hypothesis is that, at least one mean is different from at least one other mean.
cues.zh: 對立假設是，至少一個平均值與至少另一個平均值不同。

cues.en: Now, this is important to keep in mind because the interpretation of this P-value, this is significant, that tells you that any one group, at least one group,
cues.zh: 這一點很重要，因為 P 值若顯著，表示至少一個群組，

cues.en: there could be more groups that are different from each other.
cues.zh: 也可能有更多群組，彼此不同。

cues.en: But at least one group is significantly, or you know, I should have said the mean.
cues.zh: 至少一組具有顯著——應該說平均值。

cues.en: So the mean of at least one group is statistically significantly different from the mean of at least one other group.
cues.zh: 至少一組的平均值，與至少另一組平均值的差異，達到統計顯著。

cues.en: Now, this P-value and this F ratio doesn't actually tell you which groups are different, they only tell you that there is a difference somewhere, somehow.
cues.zh: P 值與 F 比值，其實不會告訴你哪些群組不同，只告訴你某處存在某種差異。

cues.en: There could be many differences, we don't know.
cues.zh: 可能有很多差異，我們不知道。

cues.en: So it's necessary to do subsequent data visualization and follow up t-tests in order to determine exactly which groups, which levels,
cues.zh: 因此，必須進一步視覺化資料，並進行後續 t 檢定，才能確定哪些群組、哪些水準，

cues.en: are causing these differences.
cues.zh: 造成了這些差異。

cues.en: Now, the reason why this null hypothesis is, at least one thing is different from at least one other thing, goes back to this math here, that the SS Between is just telling us
cues.zh: 這個虛無假設之所以是「至少一項與至少另一項不同」，原因回到這裡的數學：組間 SS 只告訴我們，

cues.en: the total variability across all of the levels.
cues.zh: 所有水準之間的總變異。

cues.en: It's not attributing variability to any one level, this is just the total variance across all of the levels.
cues.zh: 不會把變異歸因於某個特定水準，只是所有水準之間的總變異。

cues.en: All right, so this was a really productive two videos, the last video, and this one.
cues.zh: 上一支與這一支影片，很有收穫。

cues.en: You learned all of the mathematics that underlies the ANOVA.
cues.zh: 你學到了 ANOVA 背後的所有數學。

cues.en: Now, that doesn't mean that you know everything there is to know about the ANOVA, there's still more that you need to learn.
cues.zh: 不代表已經知道 ANOVA 的全部內容，還有更多需要學。

cues.en: But now you know how the ANOVA works, how it's set up, and how to create and interpret an ANOVA table.
cues.zh: 但現在你知道 ANOVA 如何運作、如何設定，以及如何建立與解讀 ANOVA 表。
